item.title: Mandelson tried to influence Starmer’s cabinet reshuffle, new documents reveal – UK politics live
item.description:
In a WhatsApp exchange Mandelson told Starmer’s chief of staff at the time, Morgan McSweeney, to ‘solve your Darren issue’ – referring to Darren Jones

The Liberal Democrats are saying the UK needs a proper plan for immigration. This is from the party’s asylum and immigration spokesperson, Paul Kohler.

Britain needs to regain control of its immigration system after the chaos of Brexit. Yet sixteen years after David Cameron’s ‘tens of thousands’ pledge, six prime ministers and ten home secretaries have overseen wild swings in immigration numbers with net migration now set to fall below zero.

Britain faces serious demographic and economic challenges, and urgently needs a proper immigration plan to support our economy and public services.

The fall in net migration is mainly a result of changes made by the previous Conservative government. We now need to go even further with a legally binding annual cap, set by parliament, at a far lower level.

British and European people are leaving in their droves because of Labour’s high taxes whilst non-EU immigration remains far too high. British families are left to pay for it with lower wages, longer waits for a GP appointment and homes they cannot afford. Mass low-skilled immigration must end completely as it is bad for our economy and corrosive to our society.

item.title: EU leaders braced for clashes over Ukraine aid at budget talks
item.description:
Slovakia, Hungary and Czechia want to opt out of €45bn Ukraine loan to fill funding black hole caused by Russia’s relentless attacks

  • Europe live – latest updates

EU leaders are bracing for a clash over long-term financial aid for Ukraine amid an effort to finalise high-stakes budget talks by the end of the year.

Arriving in Brussels on Thursday, the German chancellor, Friedrich Merz, reiterated his view that all EU member states should support a €45bn (£38bn) loan for Ukraine for 2027. “When the European Union provides funding, it does so as the European Union – and that union consists of 27 member states, not 23 or 24,” he said.

item.title: Spanish opposition criticised for AI video of Pedro Sánchez in Morocco shirt
item.description:
People’s party alters video of PM putting on Lamine Yamal’s Spain shirt in latest contentious use of AI in election race

Spanning 17 seconds, the campaign video showed the Spanish prime minister, Pedro Sánchez, speaking to the camera as he put on the jersey of the national football team. “Because this is what Spain is: a pluralistic and diverse country,” he said as he turned to reveal the number 19 on his back – the shirt number of the star player Lamine Yamal.

One day later, the opposition People’s party (PP) came under fire after it used AI to manipulate the same video, making it falsely appear as if Sánchez had put on the shirt of the Moroccan national team.
